sql.if:
ORDER BY
t.team_code t.team_name t.department_code t.created_at
ASC DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.team_code, t.team_name, t.department_code, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, e.id AS emp_id, e.client_id AS emp_client_id, e.user_id AS emp_user_id, e.first_name AS emp_first_name, e.last_name AS emp_last_name, e.image_url AS emp_image_url FROM teams t
WHERE t.team_code = #{teamCode} AND t.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT id, team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM teams WHERE team_code = #{teamCode} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}

SELECT t.id, t.team_code, t.team_name, t.department_code, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, e.id AS emp_id, e.client_id AS emp_client_id, e.user_id AS emp_user_id, e.first_name AS emp_first_name, e.last_name AS emp_last_name, e.image_url AS emp_image_url FROM teams t LEFT JOIN team_employees te ON t.team_code = te.team_code AND te.is_leader IS TRUE AND te.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN employees e ON te.employee_id = e.client_id AND e.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} WHERE t.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag) VALUES (#{team.teamCode}, #{team.teamName}, #{team.departmentCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value})
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE team_code = #{teamCode}

UPDATE teams SET team_name = #{team.teamName}, department_code = #{team.departmentCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_at = NULL, delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} WHERE team_code = #{team.teamCode}
